lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabad rate se niramale chalahi satigur bhaai ||7||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the Shabad are immaculate and pure. They walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤਾ ਏਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh daataa ek too(n) too(n) aape bakhas milaai ||
lines.translation: O Lord God, You are the One and Only Giver; You forgive us, and unite us with Yourself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saranaagatee jiu bhaavai tivai chhadaai ||8||1||9||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; if it is Your Will, please save him! ||8||1||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਕਰਹਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee mahalaa 4 karahale ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Fourth Mehl, Karhalay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹਲੇ ਮਨ ਪਰਦੇਸੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahale man paradeseeaa kiu mileeai har maai ||
lines.translation: O my wandering mind, you are like a camel - how will you meet the Lord, your Mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur bhaag poorai paaiaa gal miliaa piaaraa aai ||1||
lines.translation: When I found the Guru, by the destiny of perfect good fortune, my Beloved came and embraced me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa satigur purakh dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, meditate on the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareeaa har raam naam dhiaai ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, contemplate the Lord, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jithai lekhaa ma(n)geeai har aape lae chhadaai ||2||
lines.translation: When you are called to answer for your account, the Lord Himself shall release you. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa at niramalaa mal laagee haumai aai ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, you were once very pure; the filth of egotism has now attached itself to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਤਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: paratakh pir ghar naal piaaraa vichhuR chotaa khaai ||3||
lines.translation: Your Beloved Husband is now manifest before you in your own home, but you are separated from Him, and you suffer such pain! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਾਲਿ ਭਾਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere preetamaa har ridai bhaal bhaalaai ||
lines.translation: O my beloved camel-like mind, search for the Lord within your own heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: upaai kitai na labhaee gur hiradai har dekhaai ||4||
lines.translation: He cannot be found by any device; the Guru will show you the Lord within your heart. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere preetamaa din rain har liv laai ||
lines.translation: O my beloved camel-like mind, day and night, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਹਲੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ghar jaai paavahi ra(n)g mahalee gur mele har melaai ||5||
lines.translation: Return to your own home, and find the palace of love; meet the Guru, and meet the Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa too(n) meet meraa paakha(n)d lobh tajaai ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, you are my friend; abandon hypocrisy and greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: paakha(n)d lobhee maareeai jam da(n)d dei sajaai ||6||
lines.translation: The hypocritical and the greedy are struck down; the Messenger of Death punishes them with his club. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤੂੰ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਾਖੰਡੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere praan too(n) mail paakha(n)d bharam gavaai ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, you are my breath of life; rid yourself of the pollution of hypocrisy and doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit sar gur pooriaa mil sa(n)gatee mal lahi jaai ||7||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru is the Ambrosial Pool of the Lord's Nectar; join the Holy Congregation, and wash away this pollution. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa ik gur kee sikh sunaai ||
lines.translation: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, listen only to the Teachings of the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: ihu mohu maaiaa pasariaa a(n)t saath na koee jaai ||8||
lines.translation: This emotional attachment to Maya is so pervasive. Ultimately, nothing shall go along with anyone. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੀਆ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere saajanaa har kharach leeaa pat paai ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, my good friend, take the supplies of the Lord's Name, and obtain honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਨਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਇਆ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: har daragah painaaiaa har aap laiaa gal laai ||9||
lines.translation: In the Court of the Lord, you shall be robed with honor, and the Lord Himself shall embrace you. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa gur ma(n)niaa guramukh kaar kamaai ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, one who surrenders to the Guru becomes Gurmukh, and works for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਦੜੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur aagai kar jodaRee jan naanak har melaai ||10||1||
lines.translation: Offer your prayers to the Guru; O servant Nanak, He shall unite you with the Lord. ||10||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareeaa veechaar dekh samaal ||
lines.translation: O contemplative camel-like mind, contemplate and look carefully.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਥਕੇ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ban phir thake ban vaaseeaa pir guramat ridai nihaal ||1||
lines.translation: The forest-dwellers have grown weary of wandering in the forests; following the Guru's Teachings, see your Husband Lord within your heart. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa gur govi(n)d samaal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O camel-like mind, dwell upon the Guru and the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫਾਥਿਆ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa veechaareeaa manamukh phaathiaa mahaa jaal ||
lines.translation: O camel-like contemplative mind, the self-willed manmukhs are caught in the great net.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh praanee mukat hai har har naam samaal ||2||
lines.translation: The mortal who becomes Gurmukh is liberated, dwelling upon the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa mere piaariaa satasa(n)gat satigur bhaal ||
lines.translation: O my dear beloved camel-like mind, seek the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat lag har dhiaaeeai har har chalai terai naal ||3||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, meditate on the Lord, and the Lord, Har, Har, shall go along with you. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਰਹਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਏਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: man karahalaa vadabhaageeaa har ek nadar nihaal ||
lines.translation: O very fortunate camel-like mind, with one Glance of Grace from the Lord, you shall be enraptured.
